environment.description: Same Django 4.2 application deployed on AWS ECS Fargate behind CloudFront distribution (ID: E1A2B3C4D5E6F7) with an associated Response Headers Policy (ID: 67f7725c-6f97-4210-82d7-5512b31e9d03). The policy configures Content-Security-Policy with directive value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' https://cdn.example.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'. Note: the script-src directive does NOT include 'unsafe-inline' or 'unsafe-eval'. The policy enforcement mode is set to 'enforce' (not report-only). The CloudFront behavior has Origin Request Policy set to AllViewer and the response headers policy is attached to the default cache behavior (*). Additionally, the Django SecurityMiddleware is in MIDDLEWARE list but SECURE_CONTENT_TYPE_NOSNIFF is the only header it adds; the CSP is solely enforced by the CloudFront response headers policy which appends the header to all responses regardless of origin response headers.

config.csp_directive: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' https://cdn.example.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'
